__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Prometheus scraping the LLM router /metrics endpoint

title: LLM Router
description: Exact-model routing, discovery, streaming latency and payload sizes. Response-header latency is not token TTFT. Sizes include JSON/SSE framing, not tokens. Counters reset when the router restarts. [readability-v2] Legends and model selectors retain exact served IDs. Latency heatmaps use router histograms; engine charts show poll means. [grouping-v3] Overview groups follow operational questions; router detail distributions repeat per selected model.

panels.title: Endpoint discovery
panels.description: Last /v1/models discovery result, not inference health. Check discovery age for stalled refreshes.

panels.title: Full-request observations (selected range)
panels.description: Estimated observation count from counter increase, including errors and partial responses. Prometheus extrapolates between scrapes; missing data is not zero-filled.

panels.title: Header observations (selected range)
panels.description: Estimated observation count from counter increase, including errors and partial responses. Prometheus extrapolates between scrapes; missing data is not zero-filled.

panels.title: Full request latency distribution
panels.description: Non-cumulative histogram buckets across the selected models. Color shows observations/s. Errors and partial responses are included; empty cells have no observations. Includes request-body read and the full response stream; not per-token latency.

panels.title: Response-header latency distribution
panels.description: Non-cumulative histogram buckets across the selected models. Color shows observations/s. Errors and partial responses are included; empty cells have no observations. Time to final HTTP response headers, NOT time to first generated token.

panels.title: Request payload size distribution
panels.description: Bucketed request rate across selected models and endpoints. Size includes all messages, JSON and inline media, not token counts. Oversized rejected requests count to the read limit. Color shows requests/s.

panels.title: Response payload size distribution
panels.description: Bucketed response rate across selected models and endpoints. Size includes JSON/SSE framing and partial responses; no answer contents are retained. Color shows responses/s.

panels.title: Request size buckets (selected range)
panels.description: Estimated observations during the selected dashboard time range. Each bar is a disjoint payload-byte interval (exclusive lower, inclusive upper bound), including the overflow bucket. Sizes include JSON/SSE framing, not tokens. Counts may be fractional because increase() extrapolates between scrapes.

panels.title: Response size buckets (selected range)
panels.description: Estimated observations during the selected dashboard time range. Each bar is a disjoint payload-byte interval (exclusive lower, inclusive upper bound), including the overflow bucket. Sizes include JSON/SSE framing, not tokens. Counts may be fractional because increase() extrapolates between scrapes.

panels.title: HTTP errors / rejected / canceled requests
panels.description: All endpoints and models for this router and selected API route, including rejections without an assigned endpoint/model. Node/model filters intentionally do not hide these requests.

panels.title: Full request latency percentiles

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le,model) (rate(llm_router_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="$job",instance="$instance",endpoint=~"$endpoint",model=~"$model",route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (model) (sum by (model) (increase(llm_router_request_duration_seconds_count{job="$job",instance="$instance",endpoint=~"$endpoint",model=~"$model",route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])) >= 2)

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le,model) (rate(llm_router_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="$job",instance="$instance",endpoint=~"$endpoint",model=~"$model",route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (model) (sum by (model) (increase(llm_router_request_duration_seconds_count{job="$job",instance="$instance",endpoint=~"$endpoint",model=~"$model",route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])) >= 20)

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le,model) (rate(llm_router_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="$job",instance="$instance",endpoint=~"$endpoint",model=~"$model",route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (model) (sum by (model) (increase(llm_router_request_duration_seconds_count{job="$job",instance="$instance",endpoint=~"$endpoint",model=~"$model",route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])) >= 100)

panels.description: Histogram estimates over $__rate_interval. p50/p95/p99 are hidden below 2/20/100 observations respectively. These are minimum sample floors, not confidence guarantees; the adjacent chart uses the identical window.
